text:
If I hated you, my hatred would be given
to you in words, firm and sure;
but I love you, and my love does not trust
this speech of men, so dark.

You would have it turned to a shriek,
but it comes from so deep it has spent
its burning flood, exhausted,
before the throat, before the breast.

I am like a brimming pond,
and to you I seem an inert fountain.
All because of my troubled silence,
more atrocious than entering death!

translation.title: The Love That Is Silent
